summary.tldr: Creates a federal agency to investigate financial crimes and help recover crime proceeds, and makes related legal changes.
what_it_does: Creates the Financial Crimes Agency as a specialised federal law enforcement agency.
Requires the agency to investigate financial crimes.
Gives the agency a role in helping recover proceeds of crime.
Makes consequential amendments to certain Acts and regulations.
who_it_affects: People and groups investigated for financial crimes
Organizations covered by related federal laws
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on 27 April 2026 and received first reading.
